items.summary: On the main Home Dashboard page (`frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx`), add a new centered subtitle text directly below the "Dashboard" heading that displays exactly: "Be honest & mark attendance". Style it to be clean and minimal: slightly smaller than the Dashboard title, medium font weight, subtle opacity (~80–90%), with proper vertical spacing so it does not look crowded. The text color must be theme-aware and adapt correctly to dark mode using existing theme-based text colors (no harsh bright colors). Do not change any dashboard functionality, do not modify the existing layout structure beyond inserting this single line of text, and do not affect responsiveness or mobile spacing.
